meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后，当要求学习代码库时，Claude 会逐份完整读取所有源文件，大文件用分段翻页方式读完，不跳过任何内容，以此建立对这个项目的整体了解。
howto.when: 开始接手一个新或不熟悉的项目，或当你说“学习代码库”“读取代码库”“预热”等话时启用。

say.text: 先完整读一遍这个代码库，我刚开始接手。
say.note: Claude 会逐文件通读全部源码。

say.text: 帮我学习这个代码库，然后讲讲主要模块。
say.note: Claude 先读完全部文件，再总结结构。

say.text: 读取所有源代码，为我要提的改动做准备。
say.note: 它会完整读完，便于后续定位代码。

howto.what_en: When asked to learn or read the codebase, Claude reads every source file in full, paging through large files with offset/limit instead of skipping, to build a full project context for later work.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user says 'learn the codebase', 'read the codebase', 'prime', or 'get up to speed'.

say_en.text: Read this entire codebase first; I'm new to the project.
say_en.note: Claude reads every source file completely.

say_en.text: Learn the codebase, then explain the main modules.
say_en.note: Claude reads all files before summarizing.

say_en.text: Read all the source files as prep for my changes.
say_en.note: It gets full context before you edit.
